title: The lunchroom
logline: The mill's lunchroom, the last shift: forty lunch pails on a shelf, one for each face in the photo. One pail with a boy's name scratched in it, turned away.

panels.composition: A mill lunchroom: a long table, benches, a wall shelf with forty dented lunch pails in a row, a coffee urn, a calendar on 1994. One pail at the shelf's end turned so its scratched name faces the wall. Heavy spotting. Nobody.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no borders, heavy black ink spotting in a 1990s zine style over a muted ochre wash, a mill lunchroom with a long table and forty dented lunch pails on a wall shelf and a coffee urn and a calendar, one pail turned to the wall, no people, no words
image.notes: The boy at the photo's edge (ro_2022-11-13) has a pail. Turned away. Reserved.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Forty pails. One turned to the wall.
